messages.author: 4e956cc50ac3e075
messages.subject: new GOF test functions in package AICcmodavg
parts:
Hi,

I recently added a few utility functions in package AICcmodavg that users of unmarked might find useful. New additions include the MacKenzie and Bailey goodness of fit test for single season (static) occupancy models in function mb.gof.test( ) that includes the estimation of c-hat. I also added a similar function - Nmix.gof.test( ) to assess GOF on single season and dynamic N-mixture models. In cases where lack of fit is due to mild overdispersion, it also possible to include an adjustement for overdispersion in model selection to get  QAIC or QAICc (function aictab( )), as well as in multimodel inference on beta estimates or predicted values with functions modavg( ) and modavgpred( ), respectively.

Sincerely,

Marc M.
